canonical_project: New disaster-resilient National Data Center project (Grupo Erre / World Bank Digital STP P177158)
owner: Grupo Erre (consulting: site assessment + technical design); beneficiary INIC; funded by World Bank Digital STP Project (P177158, US$21M financing package)
notes: Mar 2025 (multiple reliable outlets: Executive Digest, Jornal Economico, DCD, oamarense.pt, e24.pt, pressnet.pt): Grupo Erre selected to lead creation of a new technology center described as the heart of STP digital infrastructure, storing vital public-administration data. Scope: site evaluation for a disaster-resilient Data Center plus disaster transition/recovery plan, because the current NDC at sea level faces flooding and natural-disaster risk. World Bank P177158 mission report confirms the contracted consultant completed the physical assessment of the existing government data center and presented options: (i) requalification/upgrade of the current data center (~EUR 0.5M) or (ii) new build - site not yet selected; capacity/status unconfirmed. Would upgrade to A with an INIC/official procurement record naming the site.
